text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Government committee will soon finish study on encouraging foreign investment in Kuwait. Panel has been formed to study possible changes to trade laws that would allow foreigners to hold majority stakes in local firms.
- Kuwait Stock Exchange asks listed firms to issue mid-year results in maximum of 10 days.
- Al-Ahleia Insurance Co. reports 31.7 percent fall in mid-year profit to two million dinars.
- Emir Sheikh Jaber al-Ahmad al-Sabah meets parliament speaker Ahmad al-Saadoun.
- Trade and Industry Minister Jassem al-Mudaf discusses ties with ambassadors of France and Philippines.
- Kuwait Stock Exchange value rises to 36 million dinars ($118 million) on Monday from Sunday's 29 million dinars.
